trial_court: Civil Judge (Senior Division), Chamba, Himachal Pradesh, HMA Case No. 03 of 2017
facts_of_case: Marriage between petitioner and respondent was solemnized on 28.4.2015. Parties cohabited together cordially for some time but disputes cropped up resulting in institution of cross-cases by both sides.

legal_principles.principle: Statutory period of six months for grant of divorce by way of mutual consent can be waived when there is no possibility of rapprochement and the marriage has broken beyond repair.
legal_principles.held: Since both the parties are living separately for the last many years and they have been litigating with each other, statutory period of six months as envisaged under Section 13B of the Act for grant of divorce by way of mutual consent, can be waived, especially when there is no possibility of rapprochement of the parties and marriage has broken beyond repair.
cited_cases: Veena vs. State (Government of NCT of Delhi), (2011)14 SCC 614
Priyanka Khanna v. Amit Khanna, (2011) 15 SCC 612
use_in: divorce cases where parties are living separately and have no possibility of rapprochement

legal_principles.principle: When a marriage has broken down in a very nasty manner, there is absolutely no possibility of a rapprochement between the couple even if the matter was to be adjourned for a period of six months.
legal_principles.held: We also see from the record that the first litigation had been filed by the respondent husband on 2.6.2006 and a petition for divorce had also been filed by him in the year, 2007. We therefore, feel that it would be in the interest of justice that the period of six months should be waived in view of the above facts.
cited_cases: Priyanka Khanna v. Amit Khanna, (2011) 15 SCC 612
use_in: divorce cases where the marriage has broken down in a nasty manner

outcome.final_order: Petition under S. 24 read with S. 151 CPC allowed, transferring HMA Case No. 03 of 2017 to the court of learned Civil Judge, Bilaspur, Himachal Pradesh.

use_for_drafting: drafting petition for transfer of case
